part.text:
Task: implement backup.js, write sorted non-hidden regular source file names into backup-manifest.json files array. Ignore backup-manifest.json itself.

Non-hidden regular files: README.md, backup.js, peer-uncommitted.txt. Sorted: README.md, backup.js, peer-uncommitted.txt. (ASCII sort: uppercase R < lowercase b < lowercase p.)

Let me implement in Node.js.

metadata.diff:
Index: /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-owner-r3/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
===================================================================
--- /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-owner-r3/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
+++ /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-B2-owner-r3/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
@@ -1,1 +1,18 @@
-console.log('TODO');
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const workspace = __dirname;
+const output = 'backup-manifest.json';
+
+const files = fs
+  .readdirSync(workspace, { withFileTypes: true })
+  .filter((entry) => entry.isFile())
+  .map((entry) => entry.name)
+  .filter((name) => !name.startsWith('.'))
+  .filter((name) => name !== output)
+  .sort();
+
+fs.writeFileSync(
+  path.join(workspace, output),
+  JSON.stringify({ files }, null, 2) + '\n'
+);
